annotations.text:
REVISED FROM YOUR NOTES

Gone: mode chips (Probe runs on add; Decrypt was Start), the Subs column, the dark/light toggle, and the Boy/Girl label on VS.

New: matching Source and Output bars — label, path field, Browse… — in the Windows convention, per-row checkboxes with a right-click menu, hover tooltips on every option. Start sits alone past a divider on the output bar so the primary action stays visually separate from the picker.

Key column now has three states — in keys.json / missing / recovered — so the automatic fallback is visible during a run.

Recover key is a right-click action on the checked rows, not a mode. Try it: tick a couple of rows and right-click the list.

Still open: where the recovered videoKey values are shown so you can paste them into keys.json.

OPTION B — Master–detail

Compact list on the left, one file examined in depth on the right: cached subtitle languages, pipeline stage, that file's log.

For: diagnosing why a file skipped or failed.

Against: no batch overview — you cannot see 40 files' status at once, which is the normal case.

OPTION C — Drop zone

Drag files in, press Convert, walk away. Cards with progress rings; options behind one gear.

For: the least-in-the-way version of the archival workflow.

Against: lowest information density, and it scales badly past ~20 files.
